_comment: Word Search screenshot capture. 500-level CAMPAIGN (valid loadLevel indices 0-499, display level = idx+1; chapters of 50 = grid sizes 6x6..15x15). Every slot is a gameplay board at a distinct level and board theme: window._wsShot(idx,theme,k,{bonus,hint,anchor,drag}) applies Word Search's real theme palette (window._WS_THEMES: sel/f1-f6/board/ink/grid) + midnight chrome, loads the level and finds its first k listed words through the real selection handler wsCheck() (mid-solve, never the last word, so no win card), then optionally finds the hidden bonus word, flashes a hint, anchors a tap-tap start letter or shows a selection mid-drag. Phone ships 7, tablets 2 each.
_readiness_expr: typeof save !== 'undefined' && typeof loadLevel === 'function' && typeof showScreen === 'function' && typeof PIPE_COLORS !== 'undefined' && typeof wsCheck === 'function' && Array.isArray(window._WS_THEMES)
